data.explanation: This letter confirms your new fiber internet contract. No action is needed now — your connection will switch on and the contract (and billing) will start on the activation date shown. Keep this confirmation, as it records your minimum term, notice period and monthly price, which the app uses later to tell you when you could cancel. If you ever want to end the contract, you can do so in writing (Textform) or via the cancellation button on the provider's website; the app will show you the earliest possible date based on these terms.
